name: DRS S3 stabilised sight (RIwP turret)
description: EO/IR sight integrated in the Moog RIwP turret with a built-in auto-tracker. Provides the detect / recognise / identify chain and holds track through kinetic engagements against ground and air targets. The M-LIDS brochure gives the vehicle EO/IR camera gun system a target acquisition range greater than 2 km.

classifyRangeM.condition: identification range — REPRESENTATIVE planning value. No identification range is published. Basis: lib-teleidoscope, the library's other M-LIDS-family EO/IR at the same fire-control role, carries 2000 detect / 1500 classify, so this record uses the same pair rather than inventing a new ratio.

sectorDeg.condition: 360 deg azimuth travel with a slip ring
sectorDeg.source: Leonardo DRS S3 Stabilized Sight System datasheet (2022)

elevationDeg.source: Leonardo DRS S3 Stabilized Sight System datasheet (2022)

rangeAccuracyM.note: Passive imager with no rangefinder documented: bearing only; not established by the public record.

azimuthAccuracyDeg.note: Planning factor: a stabilised sighting gimbal reports its line of sight to about 0.5 mrad (0.03°); L3Harris and Leonardo DRS state high-accuracy position feedback without a figure. The sourced HDC MR pan-tilt (0.5 mrad) and CM262 gimbal (80 µrad) bracket it.

elevationAccuracyDeg.note: Planning factor: a stabilised sighting gimbal reports its line of sight to about 0.5 mrad (0.03°); L3Harris and Leonardo DRS state high-accuracy position feedback without a figure. The sourced HDC MR pan-tilt (0.5 mrad) and CM262 gimbal (80 µrad) bracket it.

pixelPitchUm.condition: cooled HD MWIR option, pixel pitch 6 µm (LWIR option 10 µm)

focalLengthMm.note: Planning factor derived from the S3 sheet's own MWIR figures: 1280 px × 6 µm = 7.68 mm of array width across a 1.6° narrow HFOV gives 7.68 / (2 tan 0.8°) = 275 mm. DRS publishes no focal length.

fovDeg.condition: MWIR 1.6° to 16° HFOV continuous zoom, narrow end

mrtdMk.condition: NETD <30 mK typical, f/2.6, 3.4 to 4.8 µm, for the DRS HexaBlu 1280-MW core (6 µm, 1280 x 960), matched to the S3 by pitch and format; the S3 sheet names no core and no MRTD
mrtdMk.note: Vendor bound recorded as the value; NETD stands in for the low-spatial-frequency MRTD.

eoBand.value: dual: cooled HD MWIR or uncooled HD LWIR plus an HD colour day channel
eoBand.source: Leonardo DRS S3 Stabilized Sight System datasheet (2022)
